decisions: Selected option 2. The runtime confirms UIDVALIDITY is available after select(), but standard IMAP UID cursors do not safely preserve changed-message detection; the existing adapter has no negotiated CONDSTORE/MODSEQ implementation.
Document extraction completion is recorded only after extract_page() returns; the existing cache remains responsible for OCR reuse, while the ledger remains metadata-only and local.
PageInput.source_key must be a stable privacy-safe caller identifier; page bytes are fingerprinted but never stored in the ingestion ledger.
remaining: Do not implement a plain UID/UIDNEXT cursor for iCloud Mail without a negotiated changed-message mechanism; UIDVALIDITY alone does not detect body changes.
If future IMAP capability evidence supports CONDSTORE/MODSEQ safely, design that as a separate bounded mail stage; otherwise continue with another local/provider-neutral import path.
P0.4 remains incomplete until cross-provider incremental ingestion and adapter-level recovery coverage are broader.
